About.title: About me
About.aboutText: Ever since I met software in middle school, I've been constantly learning and improving. My passion for learning grew in high school, where I explored different web development technologies. Near the end of high school, I stepped into the mobile world. Today, I actively build, develop, and most importantly, I am still learning.
